lines: > **COMMIT STATE #290:** ⬛ **THE HASH IS A DECLARED GAP IN THIS BLOCK, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE — A COMMIT CANNOT NAME ITSELF.** This wrap's commit sha, its push verdict verbatim and its CI read are delivered in the returned report, in the filed report `notes/_subreports/2026-09-20-290-W-wrap.md` and in the ⏱ LATEST DELTA's 5b line, and the sha is readable from `git log`. ⚠ **THE TREE WAS NOT CLEAN WHEN THIS RITUAL OPENED, AND EVERY DIRTY PATH IS NAMED.** At the open `git status --porcelain` read **ONE modified and ONE untracked path** against HEAD `d96f08c7`: `notes/_dream/_GRADE-DECISIONS.jsonl`, **dirty BEFORE #290 started — dream-pass instrumentation, not this session's work, and committed here rather than swept in silently**, and `notes/_lanes/290/`, this ritual's own working directory. ⚠ **`notes/_REHEARSAL-LOG.jsonl` and `knowledge/_state.json` went dirty DURING the ritual and are this wrap's own** — the gate's append-only rehearsal rows, and the one doc row `W-290ww` this wrap minted for its own report. ⛔ **#290 HAS ONE LANE COMMIT AND IT IS THE CONDUCTOR'S OWN, `d96f08c7` — the catalogue v2 landing on deck v11 — and it was UNPUSHED when this ritual opened, so this wrap's push carries both.** ⚠ **The commit script REFUSED ONCE at the conductor's seat before that commit ran: REUSED-MSGFILE, because he put the T3 prefix on line 1 himself — #289's exact trap, met again, fresh file, clean run.** ⚠ **`git status` warned `unable to unlink .git/index.lock: Operation not permitted` after it** — the #287 mount defect, still live; `rm` is blocked here, so a stale lock is `mv`'d aside and never removed [[git-lock-mv-not-rm]]. ⛔ **SEVEN BLOCKING GATE FAILS STAND AND THIS COMMIT TAKES THE `#243` DECLARED NOT-A-WRAP PATH — THE SIXTEENTH CONSECUTIVE WRAP.** Every one is another session's append-only testimony in `notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md` — the boot-drift CEILING BREACH and six boot double-counts (#243 ×5, #264, #272, #273, #274, #287) — and **a wrap may not repair an inherited gate fail**. ✅★★ **AND NO EIGHTH WAS BORN BY THIS WRAP'S MANDATED 2f ROLL: #289's prediction was TESTED with the gate's own `_parse_boot_samples` over the exact text the roll would append — ONE row, not three — and the post-roll check still reads six.** ⚠★ **A SECOND READING FELL OUT OF THE SAME TEST AND IS DECLARED: the CEILING BREACH list reads SEVEN both before and after the roll, because the window SLID — #279 fell out of it as #289 came in.** ★ **The ⏱ delta had been drafted on the wrong reading and was CORRECTED THROUGH THE MOVER before publication; the wrong draft is recorded rather than smoothed away.** ⛔★★ **5b, AFTER THE PUSH: THE CI READ IS JOB BY JOB OVER THE PUBLIC API AND POLLED TO COMPLETION, never stopped at a colour that was still moving.** ⚠ **ZERO STRAYS WERE FOUND TO MOVE** — `git status` named no untracked path outside this ritual's own lane directory, so nothing went to `_to_delete/290-strays/`; ⛔ **`_to_delete/` is still an accumulating squatter that `4c` does not reach, and what to do about it is his.**
